pages.title: Chapter 3: Prepare Soft Billets
pages.text: §8[Step 1: Craft Billets]$(br2)After obtaining natural metal blocks, craft them with a water bucket in the crafting table to make billets. Billets are the basic forging material.
§3Copper Billet Recipe$(br2)Natural Copper Block + Water Bucket = Copper Billet$(br)Silver and gold billets are crafted the same way.
§3Fire Pit Recipe$(br2)The fire pit is the facility for heating billets, crafted from 8 surface cobblestone blocks in a ring.

pages.title: §8[Step 2: Heat in Fire Pit]
pages.text: Place the crafted billet in the fire pit to heat and soften it for forging.$(br2)Steps:$(br)$(li)1. Place fire pit block and add fuel (e.g. firewood)$(br)$(li)2. Right-click fire pit to ignite$(br)$(li)3. Put billet in fire pit to heat$(br)$(li)4. Wait to get softened billet
§3Firewood - Basic fuel for the fire pit. Crafted from any log.
§cWARNING: Use §3wooden clamp§r for hot items!$(br2)Bare hands will burn and catch fire. The wooden clamp safely handles hot items.
§3Softened Copper Billet$(br2)Obtained after heating in fire pit. Darker color, softer texture, ready for forging on the anvil. Note: Soft copper billet auto-cools after 1.5 minutes in inventory.
